headline: No Dogs in Space is back to feed your need for obsessive music history
summary: Music history podcast 'No Dogs in Space' has announced its return. Hosts Carolina Hidalgo and Marcus Parks are launching season four. The new season is titled 'Punk 2.0'.

headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang says AI fears are overblown.
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated there's a '0% chance' of AI being catastrophic. He dismissed AI fears in a CBS Sunday Morning interview. This stance is unsurprising given his financial interest in the AI boom.

headline: Kojima Productions disputes reports the studio is in trouble
summary: Rumors of issues at Kojima Productions emerged after Sony dropped Hideo Kojima's 'Physint'. Reports cited missed deadlines and budget concerns for the studio's shift to Xbox. Kojima Productions has officially disputed these claims.

headline: Trump now says he wants to form an 'AI Force'
summary: Donald Trump announced plans to appoint an 'AI czar' and create an 'AI force'. He stated his administration would not hinder AI development. This announcement comes amid growing calls to slow down AI advancement.

headline: Lanterns Season 1, Episode 6 Review & Recap
summary: 'Lanterns' stumbles in its sixth episode, returning to the present day. The series struggles to maintain narrative momentum. The review indicates a dip in quality for the installment.

headline: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story Review
summary: 'Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story' aims to be an insightful commentary on female rage. The show fails to commit to its intended message. The review highlights a lack of cohesive direction.

headline: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Will 'Easily Take Over 100 Hours' for Completionists to Beat, Director Teases
summary: Director Naoki Hamaguchi teased extensive playtime for 'Final Fantasy 7 Revelation'. Completionist players can expect over 100 hours to beat the game. This title marks the conclusion of the remake trilogy.

headline: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil Defies Expectations With $108 Million Box Office Opening Weekend
summary: Zach Cregger's 'Resident Evil' defied expectations with a strong box office debut. The film garnered an estimated $108.3 million globally in its opening weekend. This success comes despite earlier backlash.

headline: Specialist courts for rape cases to be rolled out across England and Wales
summary: Specialist courts for rape cases will be introduced across England and Wales. Funding allows victims to view proceedings remotely. Evidence can now be given from a separate room via video link.

headline: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
summary: German Chancellor Merz labeled recent state election results a 'disaster' for his party. Exit polls showed damaging losses for the CDU in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin. Despite the setbacks, Merz has vowed to remain in his position.

headline: Key takeaways from BBC interview as Earl Spencer defends claims about King
summary: Earl Spencer defended claims about the King during a BBC interview with Laura Kuenssberg. He spoke ahead of the publication of his book. The book focuses on his sister, Diana, Princess of Wales.

headline: Union calls for halt to graded Ofsted inspections over health concerns
summary: The National Association of Head Teachers (NAHT) calls for a halt to graded Ofsted inspections. They argue inspections pose a 'risk to life' for school leaders. Concerns relate to the mental health and well-being of educators.
